description: Playlist operations applied to a playlist: each vector is a playlist before, a batch, each operation’s status, and the playlist after (live segments and entries in order). Shared by relisten-web (src/domain/playlistOps.ts, applyOp) and the User Service (PlaylistEditor), so the optimistic edit shows what the server stores.

vectors.name: renames, trimmed and NFC-normalized
clears the playlist description with null
blank text clears like null
same name is a no-op
inserts a segment after an anchor
a missing after-anchor falls back to the before-anchor
missing anchors fall back to the end
inserts prose alone
an insert reusing a live id conflicts
clearing a section’s comment keeps its entries
clearing prose alone removes the segment
updating a missing segment is skipped
moves a segment before another
moving a segment where it is is a no-op
deletes a segment and its entries
inserts a text entry before an entry
inserting into a missing segment is skipped
sets a track note; clearing a note that isn’t there is a no-op
moves an entry into another segment after an entry
moving the last entry out prunes its undescribed segment
moving the last entry out keeps a described segment
moves an entry into a new segment anchored on the one it empties
moves an entry into a new segment before another
moving an entry where it is is a no-op
moving a missing entry is skipped
deleting the last entry prunes an undescribed segment
a batch applies in order
